pNone_chapter_1: In a sun-drenched colonial hotel room in Mahabaleshwar, Byomkesh Bakshi sits at a dark wooden desk near an open window overlooking the lush Sahyadri hills. He wears a crisp white dhoti-kurta with a light shawl draped over one shoulder, holding a fountain pen poised over a sheet of stationery. The bright morning light casts long shadows across the polished floorboards and highlighting the thin trails of smoke rising from a cigarette resting in an ashtray. His expression is one of deep concentration as he looks out toward the horizon, reflecting a quiet, contemplative mood.
